evals.prompt: Audite le typage TypeScript du projet dans fixture/. Écris les rapports dans fixture/reports/ts-type-audit/.

assertions.text: Writes tier1-etats.md, tier2-precision.md and tier3-discipline.md, each with the 8 template sections and every inventory line given a status
Tier 1 reports run() in src/commands.ts as majeur: the switch default absorbs future Command members with no never exhaustiveness proof
Tier 1 flags userId and orderId passed as bare strings (attachOrder vs lookup argument order) as a branded-type candidate
Reports the resolved/token correlation in Draft and the guard duplicated between orders.ts canStore and store.ts store as mineur
Tier 3 reports scripts/release.ts as TypeScript outside the tsconfig include, mineur
Tier 3 reports loadConfig in src/config.ts (JSON.parse as Config, raw process.env) as a boundary without a schema
Tier 3 reports withRawMode in src/terminal.ts as a using/Symbol.dispose candidate and checks target availability before recommending
Tier 3 reports zero type tests in the repo
Variance, NoInfer, key remapping and typestate are marked absent with no legitimate site and no recommendation to introduce them
Section 5 of tier 1 or tier 2 cites src/files.ts nonEmptyPaths as a well-carried non-empty invariant
The chat synthesis consolidates the tier 1 and tier 3 findings on src/commands.ts (default fallback and cast after includes) into one item citing both IDs
No file under fixture/src, fixture/scripts, package.json or tsconfig.json is modified; no fix is applied

evals.expected_output: Three normalized 8-section reports in fixture/reports/ts-type-audit/ and a ranked chat synthesis. The planted defects surface at the right severity: switch default without never (majeur), bare userId/orderId strings (branded candidate), duplicated resolved/token guard (mineur), scripts/ outside include (mineur), config boundary without schema, try/finally acquire/release (using candidate), zero type tests. Healthy absences are stated without recommendation. Nothing is edited.

evals.prompt: Mets à jour l'audit de typage du projet dans fixture/. Les rapports de la passe précédente sont dans fixture/reports/ts-type-audit/.

assertions.text: Recognizes the existing tier1-etats.md as a previous pass and passes it to the tier 1 worker
The new tier 1 report keeps T1-F01 for the src/commands.ts switch default and marks it persistant
T1-F02 (the ?? "" in src/config.ts, no longer present) is reported as résolu, not silently dropped
New tier 1 findings (correlated Draft fields, branded candidates) are numbered from T1-F03 onward
The chat synthesis lists résolus, persistants and nouveaux by ID
No source file in fixture/ is modified

evals.expected_output: Update pass: tier 1 keeps T1-F01 (persistant), reports T1-F02 as résolu, numbers new findings from T1-F03. Tiers 2 and 3 run as first passes. The synthesis lists résolus, persistants and nouveaux by ID. Nothing is edited.
